'''Shrikrishna Gopalrao Dani''' is a [[professor]] of [[mathematics]] at the Centre for Excellence in Basic Sciences, [[Mumbai]] who works in the broad area of [[ergodic theory]].<ref name="Indian Fellow">{{cite web | url=http://www.insaindia.org.in/detail.php?id=N90-1047 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160813001310/http://www.insaindia.org.in/detail.php?id=N90-1047 | url-status=usurped | archive-date=13 August 2016 | title=Indian Fellow | publisher=INSA | date=2016 | accessdate=13 May 2016}}</ref>

==Education==
He did a master's degree from the [[University of Mumbai]] in 1969. He then joined the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai for a PhD which he was awarded in 1975. After that, he joined TIFR as a faculty member. After TIFR, he was the Chair Professor at the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay]]. He was a visiting scholar at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] during 1976–77 and 1983–84.<ref name="ias">{{cite web
| url=http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/sdani01
| title=Community of Scholars Profile: Dani, Shrikrishna G.
| publisher=[[Institute for Advanced Study]]
| accessdate=27 September 2012}}</ref>

==Administration==
He has been a member of the [[NBHM]] since 1996 and was the Chairman of the NBHM. He is also the chairman, Commission for Development and Exchange (CDE) of [[International Mathematical Union]], for the period 2007–2010. He has served as Editor of Proceedings (Math. Sci.) of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], Bangalore for many years since 1987.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://aimconf.webs.com/profiles/S%20G%20Dani.pdf |title=Short Biography |access-date=10 March 2011 |archive-date=11 August 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110811062426/http://aimconf.webs.com/profiles/S%20G%20Dani.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Awards and recognition==
Dani was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar]] Prize in 1990. He gave an invited talk at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] held in Zurich, Switzerland in 1994. He received the World Academy of Sciences prize in 2007.<ref name="Prizes and Awards">{{Cite web |url=https://twas.org/opportunities/prizes-and-awards |title=Prizes and Awards |date=2016 |publisher=The World Academy of Sciences}}</ref>
